author: duckyinvr
name: duckyinvr.streamercam.public
description: Follows one player and changes camera by itself when they go into an arena. Third person, first person, ball cams with a goal cam and kickoff cam, free cam, fixed camera, goal explosions, kickoff graphics, ball trails and a pet that follows the player. Parts use material from Dennssen's Caster Camera (MIT licence; the notices are at the top of the files concerned).
